level_patch.story: Two glass bays can do what the ordinary ones cannot — and ordinary vehicles must never take them.

callout.title: Not all bays are bays
callout.body: The tinted lot has special equipment the ordinary lot lacks. Some vehicles need it and go nowhere else; the rest must never waste it. Park one of each and you will feel the difference immediately.

callout.title: That one will cost you
callout.body: A special bay occupied by an ordinary vehicle is the worst idle there is: nobody else can use it and this one barely needed it. The red note you got was the engine protecting the glass — every wrong placement comes back as a real error, not a shrug.

callout.title: Rules that know the map
callout.body: This booth card reads the lots: special vehicles to special bays, ordinary ones never there, and the glass kept for the ones who need it. Slot it and the red notes stop coming.

callout.title: End of the week
callout.body: The glass stayed free and the ordinary lots stayed full — that is what knowing your bays is worth. Take a building for next week.
